<thought>To find the appropriate retrosynthetic template, I will search the template catalog using the target sulfonamide molecule and criteria that match the forward reaction: formation of a sulfonamide (S‑N bond formed) and the sulfonamide functional group formed. This should return the template ID and its SMARTS, from which I can obtain the mapped reaction SMILES.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(C=O)cc2)cc1",
    "functional_groups_formed": ["sulfonamide"],
    "bonds_formed": ["S-N"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
